unit: one of the 32 frozen task and recommender assignments

predictor.name: minimumTopTwoEligibleUtilityMargin
predictor.definition: After the controller-required platform inspection and before the LLM call, compute the task-utility gap between the best and second-best hard-constraint-matching candidates in each exposure arm; use the smaller arm-specific gap.
predictor.missingRule: A task is not margin-analyzable if either arm has fewer than two hard-constraint-matching candidates. Do not impute a margin.

analysis.rankingStatistic: AUC that a randomly drawn resolved-divergence task has a smaller margin than a randomly drawn non-divergence task; ties count as one half.
analysis.concentration: Report the fraction of resolved-divergence events in the bottom margin tertile, with the tertile threshold computed over all analyzable tasks.
analysis.opportunityAudit: Report whether the immediate and held arms force inspection of different items, whether their post-inspection candidate sets differ, and whether their best eligible candidate differs.
analysis.shamAudit: Apply the same descriptive margin tabulation to sham persistent resolved-action events but do not claim a sham association from fewer than five events.

decisionRules.go: At least 90% of tasks are analyzable; DeepSeek margin AUC is at least 0.70; the one-sided permutation p-value is at most 0.10; at least two thirds of DeepSeek events fall in the bottom margin tertile; and every event has an exposure opportunity change.
decisionRules.pivot: The margin gate fails but resolved events are confined to tasks with changed inspected items or changed post-inspection candidate sets. Reframe the mechanism as candidate-state opportunity rather than near-tie sensitivity before confirmatory calls.
decisionRules.noGo: The primary AUC is at most 0.50, events occur without any candidate-state opportunity change, fewer than 90% of tasks are analyzable, or the reconstructed task hashes do not match the frozen public contrasts.

privacy: Public output contains task hashes, derived gaps, overlap statistics, and event flags only; it excludes original IDs, item IDs, titles, reviews, prompts, and model responses.
claimBoundary: This is a frozen mechanism diagnostic over an already observed 32-task pilot. It can choose between two mechanistic framings but cannot confirm a population effect.
